strengths: The independently mountable cabinet, wall plates, projecting rails, and two physical face treatments remain legible from both three-quarter views and the edge-on structural view.
Cyan useful-light spill reads in both masonry-facade and unrelated industrial-warehouse hosts while the authored source colour remains stable.
Twelve deterministic frames prove bounded electrical instability and a shared visible-source/useful-light signal without black-body recolouring.
limitations: The neutral geometric glyph and cabinet detailing are suitable for medium/background wayfinding and atmosphere, not hero close-up typography or product-signage shots.
Face replacement is currently a declared geometry/material slot contract; a later authoring tool may add automatic text-to-tube path generation without changing the fixture or host contract.
notes: V1 was rejected because all landmarks exceeded the 38% framing maximum and two clipped the upper margin. V2 moved the camera around the sign's actual optical centre and increased distance without weakening the margin gate. It passes at 29.75%, 36.47%, and 33.70% screen height with 0% clipped-white coverage. Visual review accepts the two-sided physical form, wall load path, controlled cyan spill, edge-on evidence, and cross-host transfer for medium/background production use.
